findings.description: Legacy CAV2/definitions-governance admissibility labels and the current Lab shared-authority Definition artifact concern different layers. Constants authenticate neither current Lab principals nor a scope-transfer/admission decision.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and Lab governance owners must review the exact legacy/local-role/current artifact scope and principal mapping.

findings.description: LocalBaseKind and not-DerivedFromNarrower are primitive statuses, not actual lineage independence, semantic minimality, completeness of the primordial basis or prevention of meaning drift.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and source/consumer owners must select provenance, minimality and basis-membership evidence.

findings.description: Stable name, scope, consumers, source boundary, external relation declaration and specialization condition require exact payload/cardinality/temporal contracts. Presence does not prove name uniqueness/stability, boundary completeness or specialization correctness.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and artifact/profile owners must review actual declared carriers, payloads, uniqueness and condition semantics.

findings.description: A borrowed local role is distinct from external whole meaning or automatic authority. Private contrast tags and local-boundary metadata do not establish admitted external meaning, actual reauthoring or cross-source type alignment.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and external/counterpart owners must review exact references, local reauthoring and common-carrier mappings.

findings.description: Lower layers may instantiate/specialize/compose under declared conditions but must not silently redefine the basis. Actual semantic preservation is a separate target, not a premise supplied by defining Primitive or a preserved source hash.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and lower consumer owners must select admissibility/condition checks, meaning preservation and extension evidence.
